card.name: The O inside EMBRYO in capitals
card.fires_on: The letter O that completes the capitalized word EMBRY in EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, mostly in boxed warning headings. It also fires on EMBRYOLOGY in an all-caps list.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The O ending EMBRY in the all-caps phrase EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY at the top of a warning.
